"""Recorded development probe of short source cues and audit wording, using real CUDA."""

import argparse
import ast
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from app.carebridge import guidance  # noqa: E402
from app.carebridge.local import LocalTranslationProvider  # noqa: E402
from app.carebridge.provider import SYSTEM_PROMPT  # noqa: E402
from app.carebridge.safety import check_input  # noqa: E402
from app.carebridge.schemas import ModelDraft  # noqa: E402
from app.carebridge.semantic import ModelAudit  # noqa: E402
from app.config import Settings  # noqa: E402
from scripts.evaluate_translation import save  # noqa: E402


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.output.exists():
        parser.error('Refusing to overwrite evidence')
    corpus_path = ROOT / 'evaluation/translation-corpus-v3.json'
    corpus = json.loads(corpus_path.read_bytes())
    cases = {c['id']: c for c in corpus['translation_cases']}
    old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', '6ef3409:app/carebridge/semantic.py'], cwd=ROOT).decode('utf-8')
    audit = next(ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in ast.parse(old).body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'AUDIT_PROMPT' for t in n.targets))
    provider = LocalTranslationProvider(Settings(_env_file=None, device='cuda', stt_enabled=False, carebridge_local_files_only=True, carebridge_timeout_seconds=10))
    provider.load()
    from transformers.utils import logging
    logging.set_verbosity_error()
    report = {'started_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'scope': 'Synthetic development prompt exploration; all attempted candidates retained.', 'runner_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'experiment_code': Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'), 'corpus_sha256': hashlib.sha256(corpus_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'model_snapshot': provider._model.config._commit_hash, 'results': []}

    def infer(kind, variant, case_id, system, payload, schema):
        entry = {'kind': kind, 'variant': variant, 'id': case_id, 'system': system, 'input': payload}
        try:
            raw = provider._complete(system + '\nSchema: ' + json.dumps(schema.model_json_schema()), payload)
            entry['raw'] = raw
            entry['parsed'] = schema.model_validate_json(raw).model_dump()
        except Exception as exc:
            entry['error'] = type(exc).__name__
        report['results'].append(entry)
        save(args.output, report)
        print(kind, variant, case_id, json.dumps(entry.get('parsed', entry.get('error')), ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)

    guidance.TERM_HINTS = [(guidance.TERM_HINTS[0][0], '저녁 식사'), (guidance.TERM_HINTS[1][0], '휠체어')]
    guidance.AFTER_HINT = '걸은 후'
    guidance.DELAY_HINT = '{value}{unit} 후에 잠들었음'
    guidance.HABITUAL_HINT = '걸을 때마다'
    guidance.NEGATED_WALKING_HINT = '걷지 않았음'
    guidance.MOVEMENT_HELP_HINT = '도움을 받아'
    for case in cases.values():
        if '-extension-' not in case['id'] and '-context-' not in case['id']:
            continue
        payload = guidance.translation_payload(check_input(case['source']), case['language'])
        system = SYSTEM_PROMPT
        for segment in payload['segments']:
            hints = [h for h in segment.get('source_hints', []) if h['meaning'] not in {guidance.NEGATION_HINT, guidance.LIFETIME_HINT}]
            if hints:
                segment['source_hints'] = hints
            else:
                segment.pop('source_hints', None)
        if any(s.get('source_hints') for s in payload['segments']):
            system += '\nsource_hints are phrase-level Korean glosses, applicable only to their matched source phrases. Preserve all other source facts.\n'
        if guidance.REPORTED_SPEECH.search(case['source']):
            if guidance.EXPLICIT_LIFETIME.search(case['source']):
                system += '\nGrammar example: Said, "I have never eaten bread." -> "빵을 먹은 적이 없다고 말했습니다."\n'
            elif guidance.SIMPLE_NEGATION.search(case['source']):
                system += '\nGrammar example: Said, "I did not eat bread." -> "빵을 먹지 않았다고 말했습니다."\n'
        infer('translation', 'short-glosses', case['id'], system, payload, ModelDraft)

    definitions = {
        'baseline': audit,
        'modality-definition': audit.replace('"Said there was no pain" is a reported statement, not an independently verified fact.', 'A reported statement must keep the speaker attribution. uncertainty_preserved checks only whether linguistic uncertainty (may, seems, unsure) was retained or invented; it does not assess whether a statement is true.'),
        'short-definition': audit.replace('"Said there was no pain" is a reported statement, not an independently verified fact.', 'Reported speech preserves what the speaker said. A definite quoted statement remains definite when reported indirectly.'),
    }
    for case in corpus['qa_cases']:
        if not ('quoted-negation' in case['id'] or 'lifetime-negation' in case['id'] or case['id'] in ['control-vi-negation', 'control-vi-uncertainty']):
            continue
        source_case = cases[case['base_id']]
        segments = check_input(source_case['source'])
        targets = case.get('translation', source_case['reference'])
        payload = {'source_language': source_case['language'], 'pairs': [{'segment_id': s.segment_id, 'source': s.quote, 'translation': t} for s, t in zip(segments, targets, strict=True)]}
        for name, system in definitions.items():
            infer('audit', name, case['id'], system, payload, ModelAudit)
    report['finished_at'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    save(args.output, report)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
